{{Top|leg}}
'''Fluidics''' was an alternative computer technology used in place of standard computer circuits on some systems. On [[Kamar/Legends|Kamar]], fluidics were adopted to circumvent charged particle beams designed to disable missile circuitry, as the native [[Kamarian]]s were not technologically advanced enough to create shielded circuitry.<ref name="Han Solo's Revenge">''[[Han Solo's Revenge]]''</ref> They were also used by the [[Yvarema]] because of the nature of the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. 

The system used microvalves and pipes of pressured gas or liquids rather than electrical circuits. The system made computers larger than [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] standard, was delicate to physical damage, and was maintenance heavy. However, the mechanical nature of fluidics made it immune to damage from [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion weapons]] or the frequent energy discharges of the Kathol Rift.
